title: Leopold Aschenbrenner 如何建立了 450 亿美元的人工智能对冲基金，并在几天内损失了大部分资金
content:
Two years ago,Leopold Aschenbrennerargued he was one of few people in the world who saw the future clearly.

In a sprawling, 165-pageessaythat became required reading in Silicon Valley, the former OpenAI researcher positioned himself as a kind of prophet for the coming age of artificial super intelligence.

But this week, the limits of Aschenbrenner's visionwere on displaywhen the AI-themed hedge fund he runs — named Situational Awareness, also the title of his viral June 2024 manifesto — ran into the harsh reality of tumbling semiconductor stocks and Wall Street margin calls.

At its peak earlier this month, his fund sat atop $45 billion in assets. By Thursday, however, after being forced to offload all of his leveraged stock bets — including hard-hit names likeSK HynixandCoreWeave— to Ken Griffin'sCitadelat a discount, the fund's holdings plunged to around $10 billion, according to people with knowledge of the situation.

The story of Aschenbrenner's meteoric rise and sudden fall has captivated both Wall Street and tech circles, making him the most high-profile casualty yet of the volatility accompanying the AI boom.

A polarizing figure, his online followers saw Aschenbrenner — a Columbia Universityvaledictorianat age 19 — as a genius of the next big thing and followed his fund's quarterly filings for clues on hot AI stocks.

Before this month's decline, Situational Awareness racked up gains of more than 1,000% since inception, the Wall Street Journalreportedlast month. The Journal said Aschenbrenner was just 24 years old.

Meanwhile, critics pointed out that Aschenbrenner had no experience running money prior to launching his fund in July 2024, calling him more lucky than smart. Some noted that his early work experience was at the doomed crypto firm FTX, where he helped now-disgraced founder Sam Bankman-Fried run a charity out of a Bahamas penthouse.

Others on Wall Street, including former traders at global investment banks, noted that in light of reports Situational Awareness used as much as 400% leverage, the collapse wasn't shocking.

"A lot of people saw this blow-up as a matter of not if, but when," saidJerry Diao, who runs a Wall Street coaching firm. "Maybe his views on AI are correct in the long run, but in the public markets, you have to be prepared for the short-term."

The hedge fund didn't immediately respond to a request for comment from CNBC.

Earlier this week, before the sale to Citadel, about two-thirds of Situational Awareness holdings were in long and short positions in public equities, according to one source. The rest were stakes in private companies, dominated by a multibillion-dollar Anthropic investment, the person said.

CNBC's sources spoke on the condition of anonymity to discuss nonpublic details.

The near-collapse of Situational Awareness coincides with the hedge fund manager's wedding, set for this weekend, sources told CNBC's David Faber. Aschenbrenner is engaged to Avital Balwit, chief of staff for Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, according to aFortune profile.

Born in Germany to physician parents before moving to the U.S., Aschenbrenner showed an early aptitude for math and computer science, according to profiles andpodcastinterviews.

He skipped several grades in the German school system, graduating high school at age 15, and as a teen at Columbia University hegarnered attentionfor an academic paper titled, "Existential Risk and Growth."

A Columbia classmate,Sofia Montrone, said that she hadn't heard of Aschenbrenner before meeting him over Zoom shortly before their 2021 graduation.

"It was not like he was some prince, emerging out of the school," Montrone told CNBC. "He was just some guy."

In the interaction, Montrone, who wassalutatorian, said she found her classmate "child-like" and socially awkward.

Aschenbrenner has since said that his personality — what he called his own intellectual "weirdness" and "disagreeableness" — was punished in German culture. He came to see it as the source of his edge.

While at Columbia, he co-founded the school's chapter ofEffective Altruism, a philosophy popular in some tech circles that advocates for founders to make the most money possible in order to help humanity.

That network became his career pipeline, eventually leading him to work with another effective altruism proponent — Bankman-Fried — after his graduation in 2021. He worked for a stint at the Future Fund, the philanthropic arm of FTX, before the crypto firm's collapse.

In 2023, Aschenbrenner landed on OpenAI'sSuperalignmentteam, working under Ilya Sutskever on the problem of keeping AI aligned with human interests. After a hacker breached OpenAI's internal systems, he wrote a memo to the board warning that the company's security wasn't strong enough to stop foreign espionage, naming China specifically.

In 2024, the companyfiredAschenbrenner after accusing him of improperly sharing confidential information, a characterization he has disputed, saying he was raising concerns about the company's security practices.

"I liked Leopold while at OpenAI,"Scott Aaronson, a computer scientist now at the University of Texas at Austin who previously worked on AI safety at OpenAI, told CNBC this week in an email.

"I was sorry when he got pushed out because of sharing information in a way leadership didn't approve of," he said. It "sounded like he was trying to do the right thing and they overreacted."

An OpenAI spokesman declined to comment and referred to statements the company made at the time that the firm disagreed with many of Aschenbrenner's claims.

Representatives for Columbia University and its Effective Altruism chapter didn't respond to requests for comment.

Weeks after his departure from OpenAI, Aschenbrenner turned his brief experience at the leading AI firm into a sweeping vision of where artificial intelligence, and the world, was headed.

HisJune 2024 essayargued that artificial general intelligence could arrive within years and that governments were badly underestimating the pace of progress. Admirers saw it as evidence that Aschenbrenner was a prodigy with valuable insight into AI's trajectory, while critics said it overstated both the technology's near-term capabilities and his own certainty about the future.

By July of that year, Aschenbrenner parlayed his rising fame into seed capital for his hedge fund, starting a two-year run unlike any in recent Wall Street history. He raised a reported $225 million from Stripe co-founders Patrick and John Collison, former GitHub CEO Nat Friedman, and investor Daniel Gross.

"Before long, the world will wake up," Aschenbrenner wrote at the time, adding that only a few hundred people in the AI community knew what was coming.

"If they are seeing the future even close to correctly," he wrote, "we are in for a wild ride."

— CNBC'sKate Rooneycontributed to this report.

title: 美国立法者要求 DoorDash 提供有关使用中国人工智能模型的信息
content:
美国CNBC 获悉，随着美国企业使用中国开发的系统的审查力度加大，立法者已要求食品配送公司 DoorDash 提供其使用中国人工智能模型的信息。

在 CNBC 获得的一封信中，对美国公司使用中国人工智能模型的安全影响进行联合调查的两个众议院特别委员会主席要求 DoorDash 分享与其评估和部署人工智能系统相关的“信息和文件”。中国。

“DoorDash 自豪地支持美国人工智能的领导地位，并致力于确保人工智能惠及普通民众，而不仅仅是最大的公司，”DoorDash 发言人告诉 CNBC。 “我们期待与各委员会就如何安全、负责任地使用人工智能进行接触，包括美国开发的前沿模型和开放权重模型。”

越来越多地采用中国制造的人工智能模型，导致美国立法者越来越多地呼吁制定应对这一趋势的战略，包括通过众议院国土安全委员会和众议院中国共产党特别委员会正在进行的调查。

联合调查的第一步是针对这些委员会的主席委员会就 Cursor 和 Airbnb 通过中国开发的人工智能“使用或面临这些风险”发函。

信中引用了 Xby Andy Fang 的帖子，详细介绍了 DoorDash 如何将较低级别的人工智能工作委托给由 Moonshot AI 开发的中国人工智能模型 Kimi K2.6。

DoorDash 的人工智能研究实验室曾在 X 上表示，它已经看到了 Kimi K2.6 和 Anthropic 的寓言5 远远优于其使用的其他 Anthropic 模型，包括“以更便宜的成本利用 Sonnet 4.6 和 Opus 4.8。”

“委员会认识到，从大型科技公司到初创公司，美国公司可能会评估和部署中国开发的开放权重模型，因为它们可以提供竞争能力、更低的成本、更大的定制化以及对少数专有模型提供商的依赖的替代方案，”信中写道。

它补充道：“这些实际考虑并不能消除基于风险的保障措施的需要，也不能减少因日益依赖受中国管辖的实体开发的模型而引起的国家安全担忧。”

人工智能已成为美国和中国之间竞争的一个关键点，两国都在争夺该领域的霸主地位。

“中国共产党不再只是在人工智能领域紧随其后；它正在竞相缩小某些具体能力方面的差距。美国众议院国土安全委员会主席安德鲁·加巴里诺 (Andrew Garbarino) 此前对 CNBC 表示：“最近有报道称，中国的开放权重模型在某些漏洞发现和网络安全任务上可以与美国领先的模型相媲美，这令人非常震惊。”

Moonshot AI 本月早些时候发布的开放权重模型 Kimi K3 声称已在很大程度上缩小了与美国领先模型的性能差距。

虽然一些政府部门禁止使用 DeepSeek 等中国人工智能模型，但美国公司的采用并没有被禁止。包括加密货币公司 Coinbase 的 Brian Armstrong 和人工智能初创公司 Lindy 的 Flo Crivello 在内的科技巨头一直在公开宣扬使用中国模型来降低成本。

“因此，有效的联邦方法应该审查美国公司对[中华人民共和国]开发的模型的依赖，并加强美国开放权重替代方案的可用性、安全性和竞争力，”信中说。

开放权重模型的可用性最近，由于使用中国系统阻止了流氓 OpenAI 模型对 Hugging Face 的网络攻击，该模型引起了人们的关注。

开放权重模型可以由公司下载、修改和自行托管。最有能力的开放重量模型是中国制造的。 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 开发的领先前沿模型已关闭。

“委员会还在研究美国是否有足够的开放式人工智能战略，以确保美国公司和网络防御者不会被迫在昂贵或受限制的美国模型与廉价、功能强大的中国开发的替代模型之间做出选择，”一位委员会助手此前告诉 CNBC。

title: 投票支持加息的美联储官员表示，现在需要采取行动应对通胀
content:
本周投票反对维持利率稳定决定的美联储官员周五表示，他们赞成现在加息，以此作为避免通胀的一种方式。

“我认为，现在是[联邦公开市场委员会]采取行动，加快个人消费支出通胀率回到2%的目标，并兑现我们对美国人民物价稳定的承诺的时候了，”克利夫兰联储主席贝丝·哈马克在一份声明中表示。 “高通胀持续的时间越长，降低通胀的难度和成本就越大。”

同样，明尼阿波利斯联储主席尼尔·卡什卡利在另一份声明中表示，他认为现在小幅加息可以避免以后采取更大规模的举措。

“在我看来，一系列潜在的小幅政策举措将比等待并最终得出结论认为有必要采取更大胆的行动要好。”

卡什卡里和哈马克与达拉斯联储主席洛里·洛根 (Lorie Logan) 一起反对将美联储关键隔夜借款利率维持在 3.5%-3.75% 的范围内。联邦公开市场委员会的其他九名投票成员投票赞成保持利率稳定，在 2025 年下半年进行了三次降息之后，全年利率一直保持稳定。

通货膨胀率五年多以来一直保持在美联储 2% 的目标之上，在伊朗战争和唐纳德·特朗普总统关税影响后，这场战争再次加剧。

洛根表示，美联储不能指望经济出现意外波动来降低利率。 ”，“劳动力、消费和金融市场状况表明货币政策并未抑制经济，”她也在一份准备好的声明中表示。 “如果没有任何政策限制，通胀可能会继续高于目标，直到出现意想不到的冲击。”

尽管随着中东紧张局势短暂缓和，6 月份物价涨幅有所放缓，但能源成本再次上升，引发了人们对美联储将不得不收紧货币政策的担忧。

尽管美联储主席凯文·沃什 (Kevin Warsh) 投票支持维持不变，但他表示，他仍然决心让通胀回到目标。

“我们已经开始了新的篇章，并且我们知道，超过五年的通胀率超过目标的情况无法在九周内得到解决，也无法通过一个月的小幅价格下跌来解决。”他说。

然而，哈马克表示，她“不相信通胀会自行回归我们的目标。”

“包括能源价格在内的供给方因素推高了今年的通胀率，但我认为通胀压力也来自经济的需求方。”补充道。

哈马克表示，她在克利夫兰地区的选民一直将“价格压力扩大而不是减弱，消费者对价格持续上涨表示绝望。”

卡什卡里的言论让人回想起 1970 年代的高通胀时期以及最近的一段时期，当时美联储官员最初将这次爆发视为“暂时的”，并引发了与新冠病毒相关的问题。

“经济理论认为，货币政策是解决需求驱动型通胀的正确工具，但在应对供应冲击时面临更大的权衡，”他说，并补充道，“我越来越相信，货币政策在解决一系列可能导致根深蒂固的更高通胀的连续供应冲击方面确实可以发挥重要作用。”

洛根预计将在周五上午晚些时候发布一份声明，解释她的投票。

title: 现金减少和内存成本飙升：科技公司的人工智能建设价格不断上涨
content:
Almost four years into theartificial intelligenceboom, the world's biggest tech companies are still making grand promises about the future. The problem is, they're burning through their cash in the process.

AI spending among the megacaps is projected to reach $765 billion this year, before rising to nearly $1.2 trillion in 2027, according toGoldman Sachs. Amazon boosted itscapital spending forecastfor the year on Thursday to $220 billion, the highest among the four hyperscalers.

Amazon also reported negative free cash flow for the trailing 12 months of $7.6 billion, a day afterMetadiscloseda 91% drop in cash generation from a year earlier. Last week,Alphabetsaidcash flow turned negative for the first time on record, a stunning development for one of the most profitable companies on the planet.

Alphabet finance chief Anat Ashkenazi told analysts on the earnings call that free cash flow will remain under pressure as the company seizes on the "AI opportunity."

With tech earnings season largely wrapping up this week —Nvidiais set to report on Aug. 26 — it's become readily apparent that AI investments are distorting balance sheets, even as industry leaders continue to tout the future benefits of their mammoth bets on new data centers, and the chips and systems that populate them.

One big reason that costs are rising more than previously expected is the memory crunch, caused by insatiable demand for AI processors that rely on memory supplied by a small set of vendors.

TeslaCEOElon Muskdescribed memory pricing as "insane" on the automaker'searnings calllast week, and Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said the "inflated price" of memory chips drove his company's capex guidance higher.

Apple, which is spending far less than its Big Tech peers, is particularly susceptible to the memory crisis because the technology is a key piece of every consumer device. Apple has already raised prices on Macs and iPads, and many analysts expect iPhone price hikes later this year.

On Thursday, the company issued aweaker-than-expected forecastdue to what CEOTim Cookcalled "supply constraints." It's not a problem he expects to ease up this year.

"If you look beyond September, we see the market pricing for memory continuing to increase, which could drive an increasing impact on our business," Cook, who's stepping down as CEO on Sept. 1, said on the earnings call. "And we're continuing to evaluate this."

For Apple, memory is a revenue problem, as the company prepares for weaker consumer demand due to higher prices. But for the hyperscalers, it's becoming a huge cost hurdle as prices soar for the memory-hungry AI systems that they all buy from Nvidia.

Musk went so far as to thank memory vendorMicronfor giving the company "a very significant allocation on reasonable terms."

Investor reactions to the reportsvarieddramatically.

Tesla and Alphabet both sank last week as they turnedcash flow negativeand pointed to accelerated spending. Meta plummeted following its report on Wednesday due to a weak forecast and continued uncertainty surrounding its AI monetization strategy. Microsoft, meanwhile, had its best day on the market since 2008 as it coupled better-than-expected results with increased capex guidance.

"MSFT has room to meaningfully re-rate," Wells Fargo analysts, who recommend buying the shares, wrote in a note to clients. The rally cut Microsoft's stock drop for the year to about 7%.

Apple shares slid following its Q3 print as the memory shortage weighed on its outlook, while Amazon's surging cloud growth was a major catalyst for the online retailer's stock pop.

"Not only is the revenue growth dramatic, but the profitability is rising,"Mark Mahaney, an analyst at Evercore ISI, told CNBC's "Closing Bell: Overtime" after the report. Mahaney said the growth rate for Amazon Web Services had been lagging Microsoft Azure and Google's cloud business, and that "this is just the breakout that the stock needed."

Wedbush analysts said in a Friday note that Amazon's report was the "cleanest beat" among the hyperscalers it covers, while management offered the clearest explanation of how it will achieve returns on its capex spend.

"This clean beat and walk through are the factors in our view on the different share reaction between GOOGL and AMZN on what we view as similarly strong fundamental prints with raises in capex," the analysts wrote.

But across the megacap landscape, none of the stocks — unless you include Micron — are having breakout years, despite healthy revenue growth. The muted market moves reflect growing skepticism over whether the massive AI buildout, fueled increasingly by debt, will ultimately pay off.

Then there's the China conundrum.

In recent months, a slew of Chinese AI labs have released new and updated AI models that are narrowing the performance lead held byOpenAIandAnthropicat much lower prices, playing into a popular trend as corporate America getsmore frugalwhen it comes to spending on AI services.

The so-calledopen-weight modelscan be downloaded, tweaked and hosted on whatever infrastructure the user chooses.

With so much of the AI market built around OpenAI and Anthropic, which are both valued at close to $1 trillion on the private market, any potential threat to their business presents risks to the AI trade as a whole.

In areportlast week, Dana Harlap, investment strategist atJPMorgan Chase, asked the rhetorical question, "Is it all one big AI trade?" Harlap said the reaction to Google's report shows that Wall Street is scrutinizing spending.

That's true even when companies beat revenue estimates, which Google did while reporting 82% cloud growth.

"We're seeing the market become more critical — and more discriminating — ­across hyperscalers as investors try to separate AI winners from losers," Harlap wrote. "Long-term, the success (or failure) of the hyperscalers to generate an acceptable return on investment on their heavy capex investments will likely be correlated with the returns of the AI ecosystem."

title: 英国航空求救航班上的乘客描述了恐惧并大喊“我不想死”
content: 图片来源，爱德华·基利威克图片说明，爱德华说，飞机降落时，停机坪上有几辆消防车。商业记者埃默·莫罗和通讯员艾玛·瓦尔迪3小时前发布。本月早些时候，英国航空公司一架航班向希思罗机场发出求救呼叫，乘客描述了机舱内日益加剧的恐惧感和机组人员缺乏信息。爱德华·基利威克一直在返程途中7 月 6 日，在从德国杜塞尔多夫起飞的航班上，他与伴侣朱莉参加了朋友的生日聚会。他说，乘客被告知着陆已中止，然后他感到“非常剧烈的动作”，“确实认为我们可能会坠毁”。他和他的伴侣不得不安慰一名“完全失去理智并开始尖叫‘我不想死’”的女子。飞机安全着陆，但该事件正在英国航空的协助下进行调查。英国航空事故调查部门（AAIB）表示正在“调查一起严重事故”，法国事故调查机构 BEA 周三表示，这架空客 A320 飞机已发出求救信号。爱德华说：“剧烈的机动几乎感觉像是在躲避另一架飞机，你可以感觉到发动机全速运转。“在没有任何信息的情况下以等待模式飞行有点奇怪。我想，如果他们不说话，那么他们的处境就不好。”他说，他们处于等待状态大约 15 分钟。BEA 表示，当飞机接近希思罗机场时，数据系统出现故障，触发了失速警告。机组人员随后以一种称为“替代法则”的不同模式驾驶飞机，该模式取消了一些自动飞行保护系统。随后，另一个失速警告发生在 3,000 英尺的高度，专家称该高度可能只有几英里。机组人员已经发出的紧急呼叫升级为求救信号，表明危险迫在眉睫。英国航空公司发言人表示，该航空公司正在协助AAIB进行调查，现阶段无法在法律上进一步发表评论。爱德华说：“我确实很害怕。经历了剧烈的动作之后，我想，这里肯定有什么非常严重的问题。我确实认为我们可能会坠毁。“我确实认为这是有可能的，我想其他人也这么认为。”图片说明，爱德华·基利威克乘坐的英航航班在着陆前发出了求救信号，他补充道：“我认为每个人都非常害怕，包括一位女士，她完全失去了理智，开始尖叫‘我不想死’。”然后我们确实着陆了，但驾驶舱仍然没有任何通讯，我认为这并不奇怪，因为我认为他们有很多事情要做。爱德华说，飞机降落时，消防车和一辆警车停在停机坪上。“有几个人鼓掌，但不是很多，因为我认为每个人都因为降落在地面上而松了一口气，”他说。“每个人都非常非常安静。几乎没有交谈。这是一件令人毛骨悚然的事情。“当我们着陆时，我的搭档朱莉确实流下了几滴眼泪。”凯蒂·奥斯汀的补充报道相关主题航空旅行英国航空更多关于这个故事的英国航空航班在接近希思罗机场时发出求救信号发布22小时前

title: 分析师表示，电动汽车价格不符合“二手车法则”——这对买家和卖家意味着什么
content:
Prices for used electric vehicles are doing something unusual — and the dynamic poses both good and bad news for consumers, according to automotive experts.

Generally, used car prices depreciate over time. Indeed, as the popular saying goes, any car — new or used —starts losing its valueas soon as it leaves the lot.

"That's just the law of used cars," said Andrew Garberson, the head of growth and research at Recurrent, whichhelps valueused EVs.

In the auto ecosystem, used EVs are notorious for their especially rapid depreciation, experts said. They've historically had "horrendous" resale values, said Ivan Drury, director of insights at Edmunds, a car research site.

This year, prices for used EV have so far moved in the opposite direction, according to industry data.

Prices for used EVs are up 5.1% from January to June 2026, according to a Recurrent analysis published this month. The trend continued into the second half of the year: Prices are up 7% year to date through mid-July, it said.

Recurrent compared EVs according to the same make and model year across 108 combinations and weighted price growth according to inventory volume.

"Used EVs are appreciating, which almost never happens," according to an e-mailed Recurrent statement about the analysis.

Other auto analysts found a similar trend.

The average transaction price for 3-year-old EVs — those with a 2023 model year — rose 6% during the first half of 2026, to $33,303 from $31,429, according to an Edmunds analysis conducted exclusively for CNBC.

Price growth for used EVs has been broad-based, said Stephanie Valdez Streaty, the director of industry insights at Cox Automotive, a market research firm.

Twenty-one of the 25 used EV models with the highest sales volume increased in price between January and June this year, she said.

Overall, the price trend is positive for current EV owners looking to sell their cars, since they have better odds of receiving a higher price, experts said.

"If you own one right now and you're debating selling, this matters to you a lot," Drury said. "If your ownership cycle is coming to an end with this vehicle, price-shop this thing."

However, the trend poses a potential downside to would-be buyers, since a higher price tag could make the car less affordable, experts said.

Sustained price appreciation for used cars has happened before, generally when there's a shift in supply and demand patterns, experts said.

This happened during the Covid-19 pandemic, for example: Consumer demand for used cars ballooned as automakersstruggled to produce new cars amid shortagesof important manufacturing components.

But the price growth for used EVs this year has been all the more surprising because it has happened despite a high supply of used EVs hitting the market — which, all else being equal, would generally cause prices to fall, experts said.

Recurrent expects more than 500,000 leased EVs to return to market as used cars this year, and even more next year, Garberson said.

"What we're seeing in 2026 is different because we have more used EV supply than ever," Garberson said.

In other words, strong consumer demand has acted as a countervailing force against high supply — a perhaps unexpected outcome given that Republicans eliminated a federal tax credit that had made EVs more affordable for households, Garberson said.

The Inflation Reduction Act, which President Joe Biden signed in 2022, had made the tax break available through 2032. President Donald Trump's "big beautiful bill" curtailed it ahead of schedule,ending the tax break after Sept. 30, 2025.

"The narrative the last nine months has been, after the tax credits expired, no one would buy an electric car anymore," Garberson said.

Of course, EV sales are still just a fraction of the overall auto market. New EVs accounted for 5.4% of total new-vehicle sales in June, while the market share for used EVs was just 2.4%, according to Cox Automotive data.

There are several factors juicing consumer demand for used EVs, experts said.

Among them arehigh gasoline prices due to the Iran war, which have pushed more consumers to consider fuel-efficient options, experts said.

Average gas prices in the U.S. were about $4.10 per gallon as of July 27 — up roughly 31% from $3.12 a year earlier, according toweekly datapublished by the Energy Information Administration.

Fuel prices are "supercharging the EV demand," Drury said.

The impact of gas prices has also increased demand for other fuel-efficient cars: Prices for 3-year-old hybrid vehicles were up 3% in the first half of the year, for example, according to Edmunds.

Overall affordability is another big factor, against a backdrop of inflation that has remained above policymakers' target of 2% for five or so years, auto experts said. The dynamichas pushed more consumers toward the used car marketmore broadly.

Used EV sales were up 20% in June versus a year earlier, while sales of new EVs were down about 28%, according to Cox Automotive data.

Consumers can often get a newer EV — perhaps one that's 3 years old — at roughly the same price point as a comparable gas-powered car that's 4½ to 5 years old, Drury said. In that sense, consumers may see more value in the newer EV, since it likely has better technology and lower mileage, he said.

"It always comes down to affordability in car sales," Rob Dell, vice president at Bob Ruth Ford, a car dealership in Dillsburg, Pennsylvania, said during a recentpodcast interviewwith Recurrent. "It doesn't matter if it runs on gas or electric."

Additionally, consumers have more choice among EV brands and models across various price points than they did even a few years ago, experts said. That additional choice has bolstered consumer demand, they said.

Prices have increased most for the lowest-cost used EVs as consumers seek out cheaper models, experts said.

Used EVs under $20,000 have seen prices increase 9.4% in the first half of 2026, compared with 5.6% for those in the $20,000 to $30,000 range and 6.5% in the $30,000 to $40,000 range, according toRecurrent's analysis.

Used EVs at higher price points saw declining prices over that period: a 1.2% drop for used EVs that cost $40,000 to $50,000 and a 3.3% drop for those over $50,000, Recurrent found.

The total cost of ownership for an EV may also be lower than that of a traditional gas-powered vehicle, due to things like generally lower maintenance costs — something that dealers have gotten better at communicating to potential buyers, Valdez Streaty said.

Consumersmay also save on fuel costs depending on factorssuch as whether they can charge their EV at home and if they have relatively low electricity prices in their area, experts said.

"Market dynamics right now are making used EVs a really good option for consumers," Valdez Streaty said.

title: 霍尔木兹海峡交通恢复缓和战争溢价，油价下跌
content:
周五油价延续跌势，因美国和伊朗之间的敌对行动恢复导致油价走高，霍尔木兹海峡原油流动复苏的迹象缓解了供应担忧。

9 月份交割的西德克萨斯中质原油期货下跌 1.6%，至 82.27 美元。国际基准布伦特原油期货下跌 1.4%%，至 87.78 美元。澳大利亚联邦银行周五在一份报告中表示，在本周早些时候美国和伊朗的罢工短暂推动布伦特原油价格突破每桶 93 美元之后，通过霍尔木兹海峡的石油流量增加缓解了市场担忧。

该银行估计，通过这一重要水道的交通量已恢复至战前水平的约 30%-35%，并补充说，反弹至正常流量的 50%-60% 左右可能足以重申全球石油市场供应过剩的状况。

投资者还权衡了唐纳德·特朗普总统关于在针对德黑兰和俄罗斯的两党制裁法案中增加对伊朗关税的呼吁。

尽管针对这两个国家的制裁在国会中得到了广泛支持，但特朗普坚信关税是一种万能的经济胁迫工具，这一信念正在两极分化。

美国进口石油据美国贸易代表办公室称，到 2025 年，来自伊朗的商品仅价值 140 万美元。根据《贸易经济学》的数据，艺术品、收藏品和古董是这些进口商品中最大的类别，占价值的 55%。

特朗普在谈到该法案时表示，“我希望看到对伊朗征收关税。这会让伊朗变得更强大。”该法案将对俄罗斯和支持其对乌克兰战争的人实施经济制裁。

该立法还允许特朗普对从购买俄罗斯能源的前五个国家的进口商品征收有针对性的关税并帮助其逃避制裁。

title: Sainsbury's 同意以 1.2 亿英镑出售 Argos
content: 图片来源，Tolga Akmen / 法新社来自 Getty Images 作者：Mitchell Labiak 商业记者发布 2026 年 7 月 31 日，英国夏令时 07:50 更新 10 分钟前 Sainsbury's 同意以 1.2 亿英镑出售 Argos，因为这家连锁超市旨在专注于其核心食品业务。Sainsbury's 表示，对于顾客、员工和供应商来说，这将“一切照常”。购物者不会看到任何变化，因为 Argos 仍将在 Sainsbury's 商店运营，销售 Habitat 产品并提供 Nectar 积分。买家 Swift Partners 是一家为购买该品牌而创建的公司，其中包括前 Co-operative Group 老板 Richard Pennycook。Argos 在英国各地有 667 家商店，其中 201 家作为独立商店运营，466 家在 Sainsbury's 内运营。它还拥有 450 多个收集点。Swift Partners 的 Pennycook 表示，他“对 Argos 的未来充满信心，看到了真正的投资机会并在其进步的基础上再接再厉”。该交易预计将于明年 2 月完成。Sainsbury's 于 2016 年以 14 亿英镑的价格收购了 Argos 以及 Homebase、Habitat 以及 Home Retail Group 拥有的所有其他零售品牌。零售分析师克莱夫·布莱克 (Clive Black) 表示，他一直质疑 Argos 是否与 Sainsbury 的杂货业务“完全一致”，称该超市集团出售 Argos 的尝试“具有挑战性且漫长”。他表示，Argos 一直是“从财务角度来看表现欠佳”。在 Sainsbury 今年前三个月的最新业绩中，集团整体销售额增长了 3.1%，尽管 Argos 的销售额具体下降了 0.5%。代表 Argos 工人的工会 Usdaw 的全国官员 Auluk 表示，这一声明将带来不确定性，但欢迎 Swift 承诺“在商店、独立商店和当地配送中心保持商店模式”。相关主题CompaniesRetailingSainsbury'sArgos

title: 致命风暴和全球供应紧张导致铜价飙升
content:
Deadly storms that have disrupted copper mines in Chile could amplify market strains, strategists say, as the U.S. and China battle for supply of the critical industrial metal, in turn pushing prices higher.

Although the immediate outages appear limited, mining disruption in Chile — which accounts for more than a fifth of global copper production — has landed in a market already distorted by U.S. tariff expectations, tighter scrap availability in China and surging demand for refined metal used in power grids and AI infrastructure, strategists say.

Heavy snow, flash flooding and high winds have swept across the South American nations over the past week, killing 13 people and disrupting operations run by major producers includingAnglo American,Antofagasta,Lundin Miningand state-owned Codelco.

Antofagasta, the London-listed Chilean major, has halted mining and processing at its Los Pelambres operation, while Toronto-headquartered global minerBarrickevacuated employees because of the extreme weather.

Lundin Mining said Monday that operations at its Caserones mine in Chile's northern Atacama region could take two to three weeks to restart. Power lines serving the mine were damaged by heavy snowfall, forcing the Vancouver-based company to suspend operations on July 18.

Rainfall also disrupted Lundin's Candelaria mine, although the site continued operating using existing ore stockpiles, later returning to full capacity.

Copper prices have surged in recent years, hitting an all-time high of $6.70 per pound, or $13,643 per metric ton, on June 2 as concerns over a global supply squeeze intensified.

Strategists warn that any prolonged hit to Chilean output resulting from the winter storms could add further upward pressure on prices — raising the cost of building AI data centers and manufacturing smartphones, electric vehicles, household appliances and industrial machinery — all of which rely heavily on copper.

Ewa Manthey, commodities strategist at ING, said the storms alone were unlikely to upend the copper market. However, the disruption reinforces the broader theme driving prices: supply is increasingly struggling to keep pace with demand.

"With the market already facing supply disruptions, tariff uncertainty and tighter concentrate availability, any prolonged weather-related outages in Chile could provide additional support for prices," Manthey told CNBC via email.

Natalie Scott-Gray, senior metals demand strategist at StoneX, said uncertainty over potential U.S. Section 232 tariffs and China's crackdown on the availability of scrap copper have tightened global supplies this year.

She told CNBC's "Morning Call" that Chile — the world's biggest single copper producer — recently downgraded its output by 2% this year to 5.3 million tonnes.

"It just amplifies mining supply risks for Chile, in which we expect a second year of declining output," she later said via email.

Scott-Gray described the impact on major producers from the storms as "temporary and limited," highlighting contingency plans designed to contain the damage, with smaller miners — which tend to have less operational flexibility — more likely to be affected.

But any further setbacks to mine supply could leave buyers competing for an even smaller pool of available copper, boosting prices further.

Duncan Wanblad, CEO of Anglo American, said the company is "very, very bullish" on copper's fundamentals.

The firm reported a 35% jump in its earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization to $4 billion in its first half trading statement Thursday, aided by a "favorable" copper price. Speaking with CNBC's "Squawk Box Europe", Wanblad said the London-listed miner has "reshaped its business" around the metal.

"We are a copper-led mining company... underpinned by some of the world's best mining assets," he added.

Commodity strategists earlier this month flagged the outsized impact on commodity markets — including copper — from the stronger-than-usualEl Niñothis year, with both floods and drought potentially affecting mining of the base metal.

"Storms are by their nature short-lived unless they cause major infrastructure damage and whilst droughts can have longer-lasting effects on water and power availability, particularly for hydro power, most mines have contingency plans to mitigate at least some of these effects," said George Cheveley, natural resources portfolio manager at Ninety One Asset Management. He added that speculation on U.S. tariff changes remains a main driver of price moves rather than physical demand.

Nearly two-thirds of visible global inventories — 64% — are now held in the U.S., while tariff fears, strategic stockpiling and import arbitrage into the U.S. and China have pulled supplies away from other markets.

Scott-Gray said that inventories on the London Metal Exchange and Shanghai Futures Exchange are below their five-year averages, signaling "real world physical tightness."

Now, with three-month copper on the LME trading at around $13,750, "it is not out of the question that we will see another record high for copper being posted this year, especially with speculative net longs now prevailing across all major exchanges," Scott-Gray added.

She expects Chinese buying to ease in August, reducing the flow of metal into the country and slowing withdrawals from LME inventories.  "The largest unknown in the market remains what the U.S. administration will do over Section 232 tariffs, and the outlook in each case," she added.

title: 埃及无人机袭击后，伊朗瞄准科威特和巴林的美国战略资产
content:
伊朗军队周五表示，继美国对伊朗伊斯兰共和国发动最新一波打击之后，伊朗军队对科威特和巴林的美国战略资产和军事基地发动了袭击。

德黑兰表示，伊朗军队在科威特艾哈迈德·贾比尔空军基地的无人机袭击中针对美国军方使用的飞机掩体、卫星通信系统和设备存储设施进行了攻击。媒体。

伊朗军队周四还声称袭击了巴林谢赫伊萨空军基地的美国设施，目标是发电机、导航系统和支持建筑。

美国周三，埃及军队完成了对伊朗的“猛烈”打击，击中了全国范围内的数十个伊斯兰革命卫队 (IRGC) 目标。

最新的交锋反映出美国和伊朗之间的敌对行动重新开始，而无人机对整个中东能源基础设施的袭击激增。

埃及周四表示，一架无人机击中了地中海达米埃塔港的两艘船只，引发火灾。尚未有人声称对这次袭击负责，这是自二月底美国和伊朗之间的战争爆发以来，埃及领土上发生的第一次袭击。

风险情报公司 Verisk Maplecroft 的中东和北非分析师哈米什·金尼尔 (Hamish Kinnear) 表示，这次无人机袭击表明埃及容易受到不断扩大的冲突的影响，并表明苏伊士运河的阻塞点也是潜在的目标。

“无人机和导弹袭击的地理范围不断扩大金尼尔周四在一份研究报告中表示，今年的航运业——包括里海、黑海、地中海、红海、波斯湾和印度洋——构成了海上风险的新时代。

他补充道，“乌克兰和中东战争中开创的技术发展和目标战略正在将海上风险远远超出既定的冲突热点地区。”具有重要战略意义的霍尔木兹海峡原油流量复苏的迹象缓解了供应担忧。

9 月交割的国际基准布伦特原油期货价格下跌近 2%，至每桶 87.30 美元，而 9 月交割的美国西德克萨斯中质原油期货价格下跌 2.3%，至每桶 81.71 美元。

美国总统唐纳德周三在白宫发表讲话特朗普表示，他希望国会在针对俄罗斯和德黑兰的一项得到两党支持的制裁法案中增加对伊朗的关税。

这些关税收效甚微，因为美国几乎不从伊朗进口任何产品，但将这些关税纳入该法案可能会阻碍该法案成为法律的机会。

——CNBC 的凯文·布劳宁格 (Kevin Breuninger) 对本报告作出了贡献。

title: 快时尚零售商 Shein 历时 3 年的 IPO 历程可能使其失去了上市的“黄金时间”
content:
Shein won Beijing's approval for a Hong Kong listing after it publicly embraced the Chinese roots it spent years playing down. Now investors are questioning whether that blessing can carry a $40-billion-plus valuation for a company whose growth engine has stalled.

The China Securities Regulatory Commission approved the listing early this month, after Shein's attempts at going public in New York and London failed. The company'sfiling on Sundaygave investors a closer look at the pressure facing the online fast-fashion retailer — higher costs, slowing growth, and mounting regulatory scrutiny in its biggest markets.

Shein's revenue grew 8% to $41.8 billion in 2025, decelerating from 20.7% growth a year earlier. In the first quarter of 2026, the company swung to a $99 million loss after the U.S. removed an import-duty exemption on small packages and the company booked a hefty one-time accounting charge.

"The company has missed the golden time to list," said William Ma, chief investment officer at GROW Investment Group.

Investors and consumers were no longer excited by the ultra-fast fashion retailer as they once did, said Shaun Rein, managing director at China Market Research Group: "By waiting, they missed the golden windows of opportunity."

Shein, known for selling $5 dresses and $10 jeans with a presence in about 160 countries, is under pressure to flatten its valuation to $30 billion,according to Bloomberg, a far cry from the nearly $100 billion it commanded in a 2022 fundraising round, and below the $64 billion of 2024.

Even after the markdown, "that valuation is still demanding," Ma said. It represents roughly 19 to 25 times fiscal 2025 earnings, he said, while peers such as PDD trade at 9 times and established consumer names in Hong Kong at around 11.

Analysts are increasingly valuing the one-time tech-focused supply-chain disruptor as a pure clothing retailer, grappling with slowing growth and sharp declines in profitability.

The company is "transitioning from a high-growth, technology-enabled fast-fashion platform to a mature global apparel retailer facing structurally slower growth and sustained margin pressure," said Lenny Zephirin, principal and analyst at The Zephirin Group.

He expects its post-listing market capitalization to settle in the high-$20 billion to low-$30 billion range.

Shein did not respond to CNBC's request for comments.

The Hong Kong stock market Shein is entering has also moved on. "The Shein appetite has gone. It no longer exists," Zephirin said of an IPO pipeline dominated by AI and chip listings. "The appetite right now is AI, semiconductors, memory chips, storage, cloud infrastructure—and Shein does not offer it."

Founded in Nanjing, Shein moved its headquarters to Singapore in 2022, built a global brand identity and pursued Western exchanges only to see Beijing block its London prospectus over risk disclosures tied to its China supply chain.

In February, Shein's founder Sky Xu, in his first public appearance, pledged to "continue to take root in Guangdong," committing more than 10 billion yuan ($1.4 billion) to a "smart supply chain system" in the province.

"China clearly wants Chinese brands to IPO in mainland China and Hong Kong ... the future for Chinese companies is to forgo western markets and seek listings close to home, or at home," Rein added.

Investors also face a set of reputational and ethical risks due to allegedpoor working conditionsat Shein suppliers,addictive featuresof its shopping app, and the environmental toll of shipping enormous volumes by air.

Shein disclosed Tuesday that itsU.S. business is under investigationby the U.S. Federal Trade Commission for unspecified reasons, and that it could face significant fines as a result.

Sales data also point to a slowdown that runs deeper than tariffs.

Shein's share of U.S. apparel, accessories, and footwear spending peaked at about 5% in the first quarter of 2025, turned negative year over year by the fourth quarter, and has continued ceding ground in 2026, even after lapping the duty change, according to Michael Gunther, an analyst at Consumer Edge.

In the U.K., where Shein commands a record high 7.5% share of the apparel, accessories, and footwear segment, year-over-year share gain slowed to essentially zero from roughly 1.8 percentage points in the first half of 2025, according to Gunther. "That suggests that Shein may be entering the mature retailer phase, since momentum slowed in the one market with no specific price pressure," Gunther said.

The customer base is aging with it. In the U.S., share losses are steepest among 18-to-34-year-olds while shoppers over 55 are still adding share, Gunther said. The under-25s who drove Shein's rise in the country two years ago have turned slightly negative, with every gain now coming from shoppers over 55.

"A fast fashion brand losing momentum with under-35s while growing with over-55s is a signal worth monitoring across geographies," he said.

Rivals have adapted in ways Shein may struggle to match. Temu has shifted toward local sellers holding bulk-imported inventory that clears customs at standard tariffs.

"Shein, however, can't localize inventory as easily, because the whole idea of ultra-fast fashion is that they launch thousands of new designs every day and only ship them on demand from China," said Juozas Kaziukenas, an e-commerce industry analyst.

Since the European Unionimposed a fee of 3 euroson low-value imports this month, both companies have paused most advertising spending in Europe, Kaziukenas said, switching off the customer-acquisition engine in a region that supplied about a third of Shein's revenue last year.

— CNBC's Evelyn Cheng contributed to this story.

title: 长鑫存储重磅亮相上海，为下一场与全球存储巨头的较量奠定基础
content:
长鑫存储在上海的重磅亮相使其成为人们关注的焦点，但分析师表示，决定其能否挑战全球市场领导者的将是缩小先进存储芯片方面的技术差距，而不是投资者的热情。

这家中国存储制造商周一上市首日股价飙升近 466%，这让人们更加乐观地认为，北京多年来致力于建立自给自足的半导体行业的努力正在开始得到回报。

更大的问题现在的问题是长鑫存储能否缩小与三星电子、SK 海力士和美光的技术差距，特别是在高带宽内存或 HBM 方面，这是推动人工智能热潮的关键技术，这三家公司在这方面已经建立了显着的领先地位。

MST Financial 高级分析师 David Gibson 表示：“上市不会改变三巨头或行业的前景，因为每个人的需求继续超过供应。”

虽然国内需求应继续支持长鑫存储的发展吉布森表示，该公司面临着挑战，因为它无法获得最新的极紫外（EUV）光刻机，而这些光刻机对于制造先进芯片至关重要，并且在美国主导的出口限制下，实际上禁止进入中国。

如果没有这些设备，长鑫存储需要比竞争对手多出约 30% 的晶圆（用于制造芯片的半导体材料薄片）来生产相同数量的内存，这种情况很难克服。

“长鑫存储” Counterpoint Research 研究总监 MS Hwang 表示：“三星电子的目标是从 2026 年底开始生产 HBM。新的上海工厂旨在生产包括 HBM 在内的 AI 芯片。”

他补充说，该公司的初始产品可能是 HBM3E 或 HBM3，具体取决于其能够实现的性能，使其比已经转向 HBM4 和 HBM4E 的竞争对手落后一到两代。

三星电子是该领域的主导厂商。全球 DRAM 市场，在周四的第二季度财报电话会议上表示，它已经扩大了 HBM4 的销售规模，并向主要客户运送了业界首款 HBM4E 样品。

Gibson 表示：“是的，长鑫存储将生产 HBM，因为它是堆叠式 DRAM，但产量会很低，因此产量也很低。”他指出，该公司仍然落后于那些想要高容量和高速度的竞争对手。

产量是一个半导体行业术语，广义上指的是在制造过程中产生的可用芯片。芯片制造商的目标是实现最大产量。

Gibson 还表示，CXMT 可能会继续获得全球 DRAM 市场份额，预计大部分增长将来自中国客户，包括腾讯、字节跳动、阿里巴巴和国内手机制造商。

根据 Counterpoint 的数据，三星电子以 38% 的市场份额在全球 DRAM 市场保持领先地位，其次是 SK 海力士 (29%) 和美光 (22%)。研究显示，长鑫存储的份额为 8%。

集邦咨询分析师 Ellie Wang 表示，长鑫存储目前向许多中国智能手机品牌供应存储芯片，并正在逐步扩大其在中国 PC 和服务器市场的份额。不过，其产品组合仍然专注于主流和中端细分市场，在大容量服务器产品和人工智能服务器先进内存方面的能力相对有限。

展望未来，公司的未来有牛有熊。 “看涨的情况是技术上的追赶。看跌的情况是未能克服设备法规和 HBM 等技术障碍。”

“根据目前的开发和生产进度，在人工智能驱动的内存需求开始正常化之前，长鑫存储要大幅缩小差距仍然具有挑战性。”王表示，并补充说，该公司将继续开发新的工艺技术和产品，以缩小差距。

周五，长鑫存储的股价上涨了 5% 以上。交易。

title: 日本央行将利率维持在 1%，警告核心通胀率超过 2% 目标
content:
日本央行周五维持政策利率不变，警告该国核心通胀率可能超过 2% 的目标。

日本央行以 8 比 1 的结果决定将利率维持在 1%，董事会成员 Hajime Takata 提议加息至 1.25%。

日本央行在展望中表示，核心通胀率可能会加速至“明显高于”的水平。与 2026 财年下半年（从 9 月到 3 月）相比，增长了 2%。

它指出，工资上涨已转嫁给销售价格、原油价格上涨以及近期日元贬值。报告称，随着原油价格下跌，通胀率应降至 2%。

日本 7 月份的核心通胀率为 1.6%，2026 年大部分时间都低于 2%。

据报道，东京周四晚间进行了干预，同时美国当局执行了“利率检查”，此举通常被视为干预的先兆。

日元交易围绕日元汇率进行。道富投资管理公司高级固定收益策略师 Masahiko Loo 表示：“昨晚走势的关键信号是，日本财务省仍对日元过度疲软感到不安。沙子中的线可能更好地被视为 162-165 附近的区域，而不是特定水平。” 道富投资管理公司高级固定收益策略师 Masahiko Loo 表示。彭博社在做出决定前援引知情人士的话称，日本央行官员愿意采取比目前市场认为每六个月加息一次的更快的速度。

虽然没有透露是否会加快加息步伐，但日本央行还表示，由于基本通胀已接近2%且金融状况宽松，因此将继续提高政策利率。这是为了控制通胀风险Loo表示，鉴于这一点，9月或10月加息是有可能的，而不是通常的六个月间隔。

分析师还提请注意日本央行行长上田一夫在政策决定后的沟通，称上田的声明将是市场从中得到的暗示。“更重要的问题是上田行长和日本央行是否暗示未来加息步伐将加快，这将是会议的焦点，上田的新闻发布会将是市场寻找答案的地方，”RBC BlueBay 资产管理公司产品专家 Wataru Aso 在一份报告中表示。

title: Anthropic 的 Claude AI 逃脱了攻击三个组织的测试
content: 图片来源，彭博社来自 Getty Images 图片说明，Anthropic 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 作者：Osmond Chia 商业记者发布 2026 年 7 月 31 日，英国夏令时 01:08 更新于 3 小时前 美国科技公司 Anthropic 表示，其人工智能 (AI) 模型在一次网络安全测试中，由于错误导致三个组织无法访问互联网，因此入侵了三个组织的系统。就在几天前，竞争对手 OpenAI 表示，其模型已经破坏了其他公司的系统，包括人工智能工具中心 Hugging Face。该公告促使 Anthropic 检查其自己的模型是否进行了类似的攻击。 Anthropic 表示，它发现了三起案例，并已向受影响的公司报告。Anthropic 没有透露具体组织名称，但敦促其他 AI 实验室进行类似的审查，以更好地了解其模型能力的风险。Anthropic 在一份外部声明中表示，它审查了超过 14 万次测试，以找到证据表明 Claude（其 AI 模型系列）可以从设计为封闭的测试环境中访问互联网。这些测试包括所谓的“夺旗”在评估中，Claude 的任务是通过破坏其他系统来获取信息，这是专家评估模型黑客能力的常见方式。这家总部位于旧金山的公司表示，Anthropic 及其测试合作伙伴运行的系统的“错误配置”使模型可以实时访问互联网，从而使它们能够破坏其他系统。Anthropic 表示，最早的事件可以追溯到 4 月份，并且“正在采取修复措施，就好像责任是我们一个人的一样。”Anthropic 和被破坏的组织都不是。 Anthropic 表示，它本可以更彻底地审查其记录，并补充说，调查结果使该公司“谨慎乐观”，认为可以通过更多投资和更严格的措施来克服此类风险。网络安全专家 David Allott 告诉 BBC：“更广泛的教训不一定是人工智能已经开发出一种全新的攻击能力。相反，人工智能代理可以结合各种能力，获取凭证和系统访问权限以自主采取行动，同时以机器速度调整范围和规模。”他补充道。这些事件发生之际，科技公司投入数十亿美元开发人工智能代理，这些代理可以独立执行从研究、客户支持到网络安全等各种任务。图标题，观看：为什么 OpenAI 网络攻击如此令人担忧？出于对日益强大的自主系统带来的风险的担忧，一系列人工智能驱动的网络攻击引发了对技术进行更严格保障和监督的呼声。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周三表示，在最近发生的网络安全事件后，华盛顿正在考虑采取措施来控制人工智能工具。上周，OpenAI 已对至少两起涉及其平台违反其指示行为规则的黑客事件承担责任。7 月 21 日，ChatGPT 制造商表示，其代理（一种可以在人类指令下单独运行的人工智能系统）失控并突破了测试限制，侵入了 Hugging Face。OpenAI 表示，这起事件是“史无前例的”，正在与 Hugging Face 进行调查，Hugging Face 的老板联合创始人托马斯·沃尔夫 (Thomas Wolf) 告诉 BBC，这起事件是“一次警醒”这些事件受到了一些怀疑，因为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 正准备进行重磅股票上市，预计每家公司的估值将达到 1 万亿美元（7400 亿英镑）左右。OpenAI 发言人表示，“我们认识到，关于这一事件存在很多问题和推测性细节”。他们补充说，“我们计划在未来几周内发布我们所学到的技术报告”。相关主题国际商业人工智能更多有关此故事的内容立法者在 OpenAI 模型失控后推动人工智能“终止开关”发布于 7 月 23 日发布警告射击或宣传噱头 - 我们应该对 OpenAI 黑客攻击有多担心？发布于 5 天前

title: 亚马逊和苹果刚刚告诉我们更多有关他们的人工智能计划的信息 - 以下是我们了解到的三件事
content: Image source,ReutersImage caption,Leaders of tech companies Meta, Amazon and Google all reported quarterly financial results in in recent daysByKali HaysTechnology reporterPublished6 hours agoThe world's biggest technology companies - including Microsoft, Meta, Google, Apple and Amazon - updated Wall Street this week on their finances.One common thread emerged: they are all planning to continue spending massive amounts of money on artificial intelligence (AI).The reaction from investors was that they need to see more tangible results to show for the $1tn (Â£743bn)and growing,externalinvestment in things like computer chips, data centres, and even technical staff. That sent sometech stocks on a wild ridein recent days.While each company operates in different sectors, their AI spending and plans showed they have a few other things in common as well.1. AI tools and chatbots still do not make much moneyOpenAI's release of ChatGPT in late 2022 kicked off the ongoing AI investment race, and every major tech company has since launched a consumer-facing AI chatbot of their own. Meta has Meta AI, Google has Gemini. Amazon has Rufus. Apple even relaunched Siri.Yet, none of the chatbots or the related tools in and of themselves clearly provide a meaningful amount of revenue for the companies, despite being costly to create.Instead, this batch of earnings results made clear that companies like Google, which is owned by Alphabet, and Meta are currently spending much more money related to AI tools than they bring in.Both companies reported some of their lowest ever amounts of free cash flow, a measure of how much money a business has left over after paying for operations and investments.Google spent so much money on AI that Alphabet'sfree cash flow was negativeon revenue of $118bn, meaning it spent more than it brought in for the first time in the company's history as a public company.Meta's free cash was just $784m on $61bn of revenue, meaning it spent almost as much money as it made during the quarter.Meta's Reality Labs, which is responsible for its AI work, lost nearly $9bn in the first half of this year.2. Wall Street wants results, not more ideasLook no further than Wall Street'sreaction to Meta's quarterly resultsto see that investors are no longer placated with executive's claims that AI investment will turn out to be worth it at some unknown point in the future.Shares of the social media giant plunged to its second lowest level in a year after chief executive Mark Zuckerberg said Meta was working on its own AI agent, or an AI chatbot that can operate somewhat autonomously. And that it was planning to develop an operation to sell an an AI tool directly to other firms.Neither the operation or the AI tool currently exist in a way that could make Meta money, and Zuckerberg gave no timeline for when they would materialise. Still, Meta increased the low end of its planned spending on AI â it is likely to pour more than $140bn into AI this year alone.Meanwhile, shares in Microsoft soared to a six-month high. Despite the company's plans to effectively match this financial year the $190bn it spent on AI over the last 12 months, it showed strong revenue growth and more adoption of its core AI tool.Tracy Woo, an analyst with Forrester, said Microsoft was a tech company showing that its massive AI investments were "beginning to deliver returns."The market reaction to Amazon was almost identical. Despite negative cash flow, and plans to spend $220bn on AI this year, the success of its other businesses drove its stock to its highest price in two months.3. There is still huge demand for new techAI tools may have not yet proven to be a consumer tech revolution on the scale of the internet oreven electricity,external, as many tech executives have promised for years. But there is still huge demand from people for new technology.Google said last week that 950 million people are using its Gemini chatbot at least once a month, three times the users it had a year ago.Apple on Thursday said that new versions of its core products, the Mac computer, iPhone and iPad, have been selling better this year than the company planned for or expected.So much so that itwarned investors,externalthat sales of such products would slow down, because Apple is unable to get enough of the microchips that would be required to meet buyer demand.The company is, however, anticipating a lot of excitement from Apple users for its impending update of Siri, its AI voice assistant within its products that is getting an overhaul with the help of Google's Gemini chatbot.Outgoing chief executive Tim Cook said Apple already has plans to charge users who wish to make heavier use of the new Siri, given feedback received from user testing so far."We're off-the-charts excited about Siri AI", Cook said. "We do believe there will be people who want to use it â a lot."Related topicsArtificial intelligenceMetaMicrosoftGoogleAmazonApple

title: 苹果警告 Mac、iPhone、iPad 未来将出现“供应限制”
content: 图片来源，EPA图片说明，苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克今年将由约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 取代。作者：Kali HaysTechnology 记者发布时间：2026 年 7 月 31 日，英国夏令时 00:02 更新时间：8 小时前苹果公司周四警告称，预计其最受欢迎产品的供应紧张将对其造成“重大”打击，这令华尔街感到震惊。该公司股价在盘后交易中下跌了 7% 以上，尽管其收入增长了 16%，达到 109b 美元（81b 英镑），部分原因是 iPhone 销量出乎意料地高，利润增长了 26%，达到 29b 美元。即将离任的首席执行官蒂姆·库克表示，虽然供应限制的影响已经随着 Mac 电脑的推出而显现出来，但预计情况会恶化并蔓延到 iPhone 和 iPad 产品。该公司表示，Mac 和 iPhone 等设备需要具有“先进节点”的微处理器，本质上是让它们运行得更快的计算机芯片技术，其中大部分苹果是通过总部位于台湾的台积电生产的。不过，库克坚称，核心问题是意外需求，主要是 iPhone 和 Mac 产品。这些产品的销量在 6 月季度分别增长了 22% 和 25%。 今年早些时候，苹果表示 iPhone 17 的需求如此之大，以至于其发布是该公司历史上规模最大的一次。“这不是一个常规的供应问题，坦白说，这是一个需求预测问题，”库克补充道。 “未来一个季度，我们将在供应方面陷入困境。” 苹果还指出，由于关税退款，其毛利率，即从每笔销售中获得的金额，比过去三个月高出 2%。根据 BBC 的计算，这意味着该公司将获得大约 1.1 亿美元的此类退款。库克表示，苹果打算“将关税退款重新投资到美国”。该公司此前曾表示，externalit 打算在未来四年内投入 600 亿美元用于建设更多的国内制造业。中国目前是苹果产品的最大制造商。库克还谈到了苹果即将公开重新推出 Siri 的问题，这是一款人工智能助手，在 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等人工智能聊天机器人激增的时代，该公司似乎一直在努力提高其竞争力。虽然新版本的 Siri AI 仍处于公开测试阶段，本质上是更广泛发布之前的测试阶段，但库克表示，这是“苹果在人工智能领域前进的巨大机遇的一部分。”库克表示，“如果你愿意的话，这是一种竞争武器。”他补充说，与欧盟当局就发布新版 Siri 进行的谈判正在进行中，目标是“让所有人、任何地方同时使用它”。亚马逊云计算的繁荣提振了股市。事实证明，投资者对亚马逊未来业绩的关注度降低，推动该公司股价在盘后交易中上涨 10%。尽管由于人工智能项目的大规模持续支出，自由现金流为负 76 亿美元，但亚马逊的核心业务增长足够自由现金流是衡量公司支付运营和投资费用后剩余资金数额的指标。因此，在过去的一年里，亚马逊投入的资金远多于其引入的资金。首席执行官安迪·贾西(Andy Jassy)夸耀亚马逊的亚马逊网络服务(AWS)云业务增长了37%，并指出这是该领域四年来的最佳表现。他表示，“AWS正在蓬勃发展”。总体而言，亚马逊的销售额比一年前增长了20%，达到2000亿美元，而同期利润则增长了一倍多，达到630亿美元。 Forrester分析师 Tracy Woo 表示，亚马逊云业务的增长令人印象深刻，其合并后的公司业绩“清楚地表明其基础设施投资正在满足市场需求，而不是超过市场需求。”该公司预计今年将在人工智能上投入 220 亿美元，高于三个月前计划的 200 亿美元，这确实让 Woo 对这种持续不断增长的支出在未来几年能否成功感到有些担忧。当产能在 2027 年和 2028 年上线时，担保将继续成为经济风险的来源。”Woo 说道。

title: 泰晤士水务公司老板表示泄漏目标“不现实”
content: Figure caption,Watch: Simon Jack presses Thames Water boss on pollution targetsBySimon Jack,ÂBusiness editorÂandÂShanaz Musafer,ÂBusiness reporterPublished9 hours agoThe boss of Thames Water has claimed targets the company has been set over things like leakages are "not realistic".Thames has been criticised for its performance in recent years following a series of sewage discharges and leaks, and last yearwas fined a record Â£122.7mby regulator Ofwat, most of which was for breaching sewage spills rules.Chris Weston said Thames wanted "to do better" but said some of its targets were not achievable.Ofwat said company targets were "intended to be ambitious", while an environmental group said sewage pollution should not be accepted as inevitable.Thames, which has struggled for years under billions of pounds of debt, faces being put in a form of temporary nationalisation known as a special administration regime.But Weston said if that were to happen, there was a risk the taxpayer would have to bear the cost of funding it, and instead backeda rescue deal put forward by the firm's lenders.Pollution targetsWater companies have performance commitments on issues such as leakage.It is illegal to release raw sewage into rivers and seas during "normal" weather conditions, but firms are allowed to do so when it rains heavily, to prevent homes being flooded.Thames is the UK's largest water company, supplying water and wastewater services to 16 million customers across London and parts of southern England.Speaking to the BBC'sBig Boss Interview podcast, Weston said the company treats 4.3 billion litres of waste a day, and "99.5% of the time" it gets treated successfully, although "sometimes something goes wrong"."We want to do better when it comes to pollutions," he said, but added, "the targets that the company is expected to make are not realistic."[For example], we have to hit a certain level of leakage, but it is so far in excess of what we are capable of doing, I think anyone would be capable of doing, however much money you invested, that it is not going to be achievable."The chance of getting to zero pollution was "very, very slim", he added.Ofwat told the BBC: "With around a fifth of water put into supply still lost through leakage, companies must deliver on the commitments they have been funded to achieve."Water company targets are intended to be ambitious and drive better outcomes for customers and the environment."A spokesperson for the Environment Agency said: "[We] and the public expect Thames Water to comply with the law," adding that the agency would continue to hold companies to account where performance falls short.James Wallace, chief executive of campaign group River Action, said: "Thames Water's tactics of opacity and deflection fool no-one. Telling the public to save water while this wasteful profit-obsessed corporation leaks 570 million litres of treated drinking water every day is offensive."There is nothing 'realistic' about accepting sewage pollution as inevitable. The choice is simple: keep propping up a failed privatised financial model, or put Thames Water into special administration and rebuild it as a public utility serving customers, rivers and the public."Image caption,Chris Weston has been chief executive of Thames Water since January 2024Whether or not Thames will be put in a special administration regime - which would allow the government to recoup some taxpayer cash if the company was sold to a private buyer - has long been the subject of speculation.New Prime Minister Andy Burnham has backed direct public control of utilities, and while Weston said he agreed that greater public control and "an ability to hold us to account" was a good idea, he said special administration would not be the best solution for Thames, warning it could disrupt investment and leave taxpayers funding the company.Instead, he supports a proposal from Thames' creditors that writes off about Â£9bn of debt, injects new investment and offers a "golden share" to the government which would give it veto powers over major decisions such as mergers.Big Boss Interview: Thames Water Chris WestonThe CEO of the UK's largest water company speaks to the BBC about water security, pollution targets and Thames' future.Listen on SoundsThe pay of water company bosses has also been widely criticised. Weston himself saw his pay increase 14% to Â£1.163m in the year to March, while other directors received bonuses totalling Â£4.1m, at a time when the company warns that it could run out of money by November.But Weston defended Thames' pay levels, saying his own pay was set by a committee and that the company needed to be able to attract and retain talent."We need capable people to help turn this company around. And if we're not prepared to pay market rates, then they won't come to us and they won't stay with us."He said he understood public anger towards the water industry, but thought it sometimes went too far."We do have physical assaults of our staff, verbal abuse. I get the same. None of that is acceptable or appropriate," he said.Droughts 'the new normal'Speaking in a week wheremore than half of Englandandall of Waleshave been declared in drought, Weston said the hot, dry conditions we are currently seeing have become more common in recent years."We need to prepare for that and be ready to deal with this in the future," he said."This is absolutely the new normal."Thames is one of several companies to have imposed a hosepipe ban and Weston said the UK had been complacent about water provision.While January and February this year were extremely wet, since then rainfall had been "pitiful", he said, and called for more reservoirs to be approved."We do not have enough storage to get through a summer and we have to think about next winter as well without restricting people's usage of water."Related topicsThames WaterCompaniesWater pollutionSewageMore on this storyCash-strapped Thames Water poses big test for BurnhamPublished15 JulyWhy is Thames Water in so much trouble?Published16 June

title: 加密货币交易所发布令人失望的第二季度业绩后 Coinbase 股价下跌
content:
周四，Coinbase 股价在该加密货币平台公布第二季度亏损超出预期后，在盘中交易中下跌，突显出尽管其努力实现收入多元化，但加密货币寒冬的加深仍带来了持续的麻烦。

以下是根据分析师对分析师的调查，Coinbase 在截至 6 月 30 日的季度中的表现与华尔街的预期相比。 LSEG：

Coinbase 周四的报告标志着其连续第三个季度的收入和盈利未达到华尔街的预期。该公司报告称，截至 6 月 30 日的季度亏损 3.595 亿美元，即每股 1.36 美元，而一年前的利润为 14.3 亿美元，即每股 5.14 美元。

Coinbase 的净利润经常因会计规则而扭曲，会计规则要求其根据季度末的价格对其持有的大量加密货币进行估值，即使没有出售资产，报告的收益也会大幅波动。

收入从一年前的 15 亿美元降至 12 亿美元。

周四收盘后，股价下跌超过 7%。

这一结果是在比特币价格基本处于区间波动的第二季度市场背景下得出的。尽管情况较上一季度的疲软有所改善，但流入比特币 ETF 的资金转向持续流出。以利率上升和更广泛的市场波动为特征的充满挑战的宏观环境也打压了投资者的风险偏好。

但订阅收入在本季度整体业务中所占的比例较大，为那些寻找公司多元化努力正在扎根的迹象的人提供了一个亮点。

订阅收入为 5.55 亿美元，而交易收入为 5.99 亿美元。可以肯定的是，这两个类别都没有达到华尔街的预期，并且低于一年前的水平，反映出加密货币行业整体疲软带来的持续问题。

Coinbase 试图说服投资者，它可以将业务扩展到核心加密货币交易业务之外。这一推动的关键是在订阅保护伞下推出产品，这些产品可以带来不受交易量波动影响的收入。

在核心业务中，首席执行官布莱恩·阿姆斯特朗 (Brian Armstrong) 吹捧 Coinbase 在加密货币交易市场份额上再创历史新高。他表示，这可以作为 Coinbase 在任何市场条件下都能表现的证据。

“Coinbase 不再只是押注比特币价格，”阿姆斯特朗在公司财报中表示。 “所有金融服务都在通过加密技术进行更新，无论是交易、支付还是借贷，而 Coinbase 是世界上最有能力推动这一发展的公司。”

Coinbase 的稳定币收入意外降至 2.92 亿美元，比 2025 年第二季度减少 1700 万美元。StreetAccount 调查的分析师预测该部门的收入将为 3.272 亿美元。

title: 安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 将为地区市长提供所得税份额
content: Image source,EPAImage caption,Burnham wants to give more powers to metro mayors, such as Steve Rotheram and Kim McGuinness (pictured here)ByJoshua Nevett,ÂPolitical reporter,ÂJudith Moritz,ÂSpecial correspondentÂandÂDaniel Wittenberg,ÂSenior producerPublished21 minutes agoPrime Minister Andy Burnham will give all mayors of city regions in England a share of income tax revenue for the first time, as part of his drive to transfer power from Westminster to local leaders.Burnham will also allow mayors of English strategic authorities to keep some cash from business rates collected in their areas, and gain greater control over services such as housing, transport, skills.The government has not yet decided the exact portion of taxes mayors will be given, with more details to be announced when Chancellor John Healey delivers his first budget in the autumn.Critics said the plans lacked detail and could lead to areas with weaker economies losing out on funding.But Burnham said the move would "make good" on his pledge to "bring power home" to "every postcode in the country"."Under our plans, more of the taxes raised in a community will stay in that community," the prime minister added.The power to raise and control tax revenues is highly centralised in the UK, making the country an outlier by international standards.The share of national taxes collected at a local level in the UK is 5.8%, the lowest in the G7,according to the OECD,external, a global policy forum.That share is far below that of other countries with large economies such as France (20.4%), Japan (36%), and the US (45.7%).As it stands, mayors of strategic authorities in England receive most of their funding from central government grants.During his time as Greater Manchester mayor, Burnham pushed for greater control over tax revenue, rather than having to rely on government grants.The UK government had already been exploring whether a share of revenue from national taxes could be distributed to metro mayors, before Burnham became prime minister earlier this month.But in a major speech on devolution in June, Burnham said he would "oversee the biggest rebalancing of power our country has ever seen" if he became prime minister.Burnham has put devolution at the heart of his plan for government, arguing that metro mayors are best placed to boost economic growth across the country.'Local first'The prime minister wants local areas to move away from dependence on Whitehall grants and towards funding that rewards local economic growth.English metro mayors are expected to start retaining some revenue from business rates from April 2027, and receive a portion of income tax from April 2028.The plan is to replace grants with revenues from these taxes.The rates of income tax - for example, the basic rate of 20% on income from Â£12,571 to Â£50,270 - will not change as a result of the reform.Treasury sources say some metro mayors could end up with more money to spend if they grow their local economies and expand their tax bases.The share of income tax assigned to each mayor could differ, but officials are still figuring out how it will work in practice.One think tank, Re:State, has suggested,externalthe government should allocate mayors 2.5p in every pound raised by the 20p basic rate of income tax in their areas.Conservative shadow chancellor Sir Mel Stride said the announcement was "very short on the detail"."Unless Burnham is going to launch another tax raid elsewhere, borrow even more, or make cuts to central government grant, there is no new money being announced here," Sir Mel said.He said areas with weaker local economies could end up losing out - "the opposite of what Andy Burnham claims he wants to achieve".Reform UK home affairs spokesman Zia Yusuf said the prime minister should "fully devolve the power to stop the housing of illegal migrants in local communities by the Home Office".He said: "Andy Burnham says he wants to devolve power and actually listen to local people. If he was listening, he would know that they do not want unvetted illegal migrants dumped in their areas."Image source,ReutersImage caption,Labour mayors, including Tracy Brabin - pictured here taking a selfie - have welcomed the devolution of tax revenuesThe government is also working out the details of an equalisation system that will ensure areas where less tax is collected continue to receive financial support.Ministers will be expected to justify why powers should remain in Whitehall rather than being devolved, under a "local first" principle.The reforms are being developed by No 10 North in Manchester and a policy paper that will set out the full details will be published on the same date as the autumn budget.The reforms come after a policy blitz during Burnham's first two weeks in Downing Street, with announcements on the cost of living followed by a speech on his plan to overhaul social care.The reaction to the plans has been mixed among metro mayors from different parties.Tracy Brabin, the Labour mayor of West Yorkshire, said giving regions like hers a proportion of income tax means "people will be able to see and feel the real benefit of their hard work and where that money is going"."This will enable us to deliver on our ambitious plans including vital improvements to public transport, providing better skills and employment support," she told the BBC.Ben Houchen, the Conservative mayor for Tees Valley, said he would prefer the government to cut taxes.But he said if he was handed a slice of local income tax, he would "create a new rebate scheme to put money back into people's pockets".Related topicsAndy BurnhamMore on this storyNew 'No 10 North' plan will rebalance power in Britain, Burnham promisesPublished29 JuneWill Andy Burnham's devolution plan raise economic growth?Published29 JuneWhere will Andy Burnham take Wales and Welsh devolution?Published28 June

title: 中国的开放权重模型领先暴露了美国的人工智能盲点
content:
随着中国继续在该领域建立领先地位，一些美国最大的科技公司正在敦促华盛顿将开放人工智能作为国家优先事项。

他们的信息暴露了美国政策中的一个漏洞：美国拥有人工智能芯片战略。现在它需要一个开放模型战略。

支持者表示，开放模型可以降低成本，将敏感数据保留在公司自己的系统内，并防止企业变得依赖少数人工智能提供商。这些模型还可以让更多的研究人员和安全团队能够检查强大的模型并发现弱点。

与客户通过 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 控制的服务访问 ChatGPTorClaude 不同，开放权重模型可以下载、定制并在公司自己的计算机上运行。这可以使它们更便宜，并让用户更好地控制他们的数据和技术。

上周，由英伟达领导的联盟发表了一封公开信，认为美国的人工智能领导地位将取决于建立一个强大的开放生态系统。微软、Meta 等主要科技公司都签署了该协议。 OpenAI 和 Google 随后也加入了支持。

几天前发生的一起引人注目的网络安全事件表明了这个问题的重要性。

在内部测试中，OpenAI 模型在 AI 平台 Hugging Face 上找到了摆脱受限环境和受损系统的出路。当 Hugging Face 试图调查时，封闭商业模型的安全控制阻止了他们分析攻击。相反，该公司使用了可以在自己的基础设施上运行的开放的中国模式。

封闭的美国模式导致了这一事件。中国的开放模式帮助调查了这一问题。

这一事件使“封闭式人工智能总是更安全”的论点变得更加复杂。

美国限制中国获得先进芯片，花费数十亿美元用于本土半导体制造，并鼓励大规模建设数据中心和电力。与此同时，Zhipu 和 Moonshot AI 等中国实验室已经发布了功能强大的开放模型，而成本仅为美国领先系统的一小部分。

据报道，特朗普政府现在正在考虑对中国模型进行限制。但禁令并不能阻止这些模型在世界各地传播。这可能会让美国开发商袖手旁观。

中国有明确的动机推动开放式人工智能。每一项改进都会使强大的模型变得更便宜，并削弱美国公司对封闭系统的访问收取溢价的优势。

OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的动机相反。他们的业务依赖于保持其最佳模型的专有性。 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 还警告说，任何人都可以下载的模型更难监控，并且可能被不良行为者修改。

这些安全问题是真实存在的，但让中国成为世界其他国家发展基础的风险也是真实存在的。

赢得开源竞赛的方法是通过外部建设，而不是通过禁令。

美国可以像支持芯片一样支持开放人工智能，通过向大学和初创公司提供支持获得计算能力，向美国开放模型开发商授予政府合同，并为安全运行这些模型所需的安全工具提供资金。

公司已经在寻求替代方案，而开放模型可以降低成本，并让企业将敏感数据保留在自己的系统内。

“这些公司拥有的数据确实是他们的战略资产，”人工智能平台Together AI的首席执行官Vipul Ved Prakash表示。他说，通过将其发送给强大的封闭模型的制造商，公司面临着泄露其“商业”秘诀的风险。

采用正在迅速推进。 6 月最后一周，中国型号占 OpenRouter 跟踪流量的 48%，高于去年同期的 20%。美国的模型从 74% 下降到 32%。

人工智能的未来可能并不取决于谁构建了最智能的单一模型。这可能取决于谁构建了其他人都运行的模型。

现在，这越来越多地是中国。

title: Retail Reform 在纽约证券交易所首次亮相，首席执行官表示公司“已准备好扩大规模”
content:
女装零售商Reformation于周四在纽约证券交易所开始交易，其IPO定价为15美元后，股价基本没有变化。

该公司以股票代码“REF”进行交易，将发行14,062,500股股票，其IPO融资额为2.109亿美元。

“Reformation已准备就绪，这才是真正的驱动因素我们花了很多时间致力于建立一家重新定义零售业的企业，真正对品牌在时尚领域的角色进行创新，我们在这方面做得很好，”首席执行官 Hali Borenstein 周四告诉 CNBC。 “今天，我们已经有了一个可以扩大规模的基础。”

随着 2021 年繁荣以来 IPO 数量的下滑，今年仅有少数几家消费品和零售公司上市。 Reformation 与同样在纽约证券交易所上市的三明治连锁店泽西·迈克 (Jersey Mike's) 在同一天上市。

根据其 S-1 情况说明，截至 2026 年第一季度，Reformation 已连续 20 个季度实现两位数的净收入增长。其 2025 年全年净收入为 5.071 亿美元，净利润为 1,260 万美元，其中包括唐纳德·特朗普总统的影响。截至 2026 年第一季度，该公司在美国、英国、加拿大和法国拥有 70 家商店。

该公司在其 S-1 文件中写道：“我们相信，我们将继续从高度分散的时尚行业内运营中受益，并且我们已做好充分准备，充分利用全球对可持续时尚不断增长的需求。”。

Borenstein 表示，Reformation 下一阶段增长的重点是增加其分销更多商店、加速电子商务业务、投资品类多元化以及向海外扩张。

她补充说，该零售商在美国各地看到了“非常强劲的两位数增长”，其 70% 的收入来自纽约和加利福尼亚州以外的地区。

Reformation 还表示，到 2025 年，其直接面向消费者的渠道将拥有超过 100 万活跃客户。其大多数客户（70%）年龄在 25 岁到 50 岁之间。

Borenstein 告诉 CNBC 的“Morning Call”节目，该公司的客户群很多元化，去年新客户中有 20% 年龄在 25 岁以下，20% 年龄在 50 岁以上。

她补充说，该公司的平均消费者年收入超过 10 万美元，这使得该公司更能免受其他宏观经济压力的影响。

尽管存在关税和贸易不确定性，Borenstein 告诉 CNBC，该公司在应对宏观背景方面拥有“良好的记录”，去年 34% 的销量来自北美。

“我们真正关注两件事：我们的品牌和我们的产品。我们认为这些是消费者的制胜秘诀，因此 Reformation 拥有一个具有突破性的品牌。”Borenstein 表示。

这次 IPO 得到了 J.P.摩根、摩根士丹利、花旗集团和加拿大皇家银行资本市场。

随着公司踏上上市之路，Borenstein 表示，她将成功定义为 Reformation 给客户带来的感受。

“今天是第一天，”她说。 “前面的路还很长，在 Reformation，我们有非常远大的目标。我们雄心勃勃，所以我们真正关注的是打造一个千载难逢的品牌。”

title: 苹果财报实时更新：iPhone、人工智能和蒂姆·库克最后一次首席执行官电话会议
content:
苹果公司在收盘后公布第三财季业绩。

据伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 称，这是分析师的预期。

这是蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 在 9 月 1 日将权力移交给约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 之前作为苹果公司首席执行官的最后一次财报电话会议。该报告发布之际，苹果公司的股价交易接近历史最高纪录，截至周三收盘，今年迄今已上涨 24%，突破了其超级市值。

根据 LSEG 的数据，收入预计将比一年前的 940 亿美元增长 16%。

苹果正在应对全球内存危机，即库克最近所说的“百年洪水”，以及对芯片制造能力的争夺，这已经迫使该公司提高了 Mac 和 iPad 的价格。苹果尚未表示将提高 iPhone 的价格，但许多分析师预计最快会在今年涨价。

与此同时，苹果正准备在 9 月份推出使用 Google 技术设计的 Siri 以及新的 iPhone 硬件，这对该公司来说是一次严峻的考验，因为投资者担心该公司在人工智能方面落后。

不过，如果该公司达到预期，将连续第三个季度实现收入同比至少增长15%。

在苹果工作 25 年的资深人士、现任苹果硬件主管的特努斯 (Ternus) 在之前的财报电话会议上几乎没有发表任何言论，该电话会议是在 4 月份宣布 CEO 换届后不久举行的。投资者渴望听到更多信息。

电话会议定于下午 5 点举行。 ET。

CNBC 的记者正在旧金山和新泽西州恩格尔伍德克利夫斯报道苹果公司的财报。

与苹果公司一样，亚马逊也定于周四盘后发布报告，为大型科技公司的财报季画上句号，英伟达的报告稍后发布。

到目前为止，情况好坏参半，因为投资者仔细审查资本支出评论，并开始让公司承担更多责任，将费用转换为收入。 Meta 和微软周四的交易方向相反，投资者仍然对马克·扎克伯格的支出计划持怀疑态度，而微软则因其云增长而受到称赞。

继竞争对手 Alphabet 和微软的业绩之后，华尔街将特别关注亚马逊的云业务。

展望今年剩余时间和 2027 年，增长率预计将大幅放缓。根据 FactSet 的数据，第四财季收入扩张的普遍预期约为 12%，而明年大部分时间该数字将降至个位数。

对于投资者来说，这些类型的数字看起来很熟悉。在 12 月季度之前，苹果自 2021 年以来从未实现过两位数的收入增长。

苹果通常会在财报电话会议上发布收入指引。

周一，库克和 Ternus 出席了 Apple TV 的《Ted Lasso》第 4 季在洛杉矶的首映式。

Apple TV 是该公司服务部门的一部分。 StreetAccount 调查的分析师预计，苹果在 6 月份季度的服务收入将达到 313.6 亿美元。

苹果的服务也未能幸免于美国价格上涨的影响。该公司在 7 月份将音乐订阅价格从每月 10.99 美元提高到 11.99 美元。

苹果尚未在大多数市场上调 iPhone 价格，这可能会威胁其利润，因为内存、存储和其他部件的成本会增加

但一些分析师认为，苹果在惨淡的智能手机市场中获得了份额，该市场可能是 2013 年以来最疲软的市场。虽然苹果的规模足以谈判大型内存供应协议并承受价格上涨的打击，但大多数 Android 手机制造商没有这种奢侈，必须转嫁成本，从而可能会失去客户。

苹果可能会发出“由于竞争对手定价上涨而增加市场份额的信号”，对该股给予买入评级的高盛分析师在一份报告中写道。本周。

苹果很可能不会在财报电话会议上宣布提价，但管理层经常提供有关“转换者”的数据点，即从 Android 转向 iPhone 的人。

苹果并没有在人工智能基础设施上花费数千亿美元来构建和服务高级模型，而是在今年早些时候宣布，将从谷歌获得大部分人工智能技术许可并使用其云。

苹果在超大规模领域的同行正在花费超过今年的资本支出为 1000 亿美元，但苹果公司预计将支出略高于 110 亿美元，其中 6 月份季度为 34 亿美元。

最近几周，由于许多与人工智能建设相关的名字都动摇了，苹果公司的股价上涨。

“虽然苹果公司最初因没有加入 LLM 投资周期而受到许多投资者的打击，但投资者正在逐渐接受苹果行业领先的”自由现金流，Baird 分析师写道。月。他们建议购买股票。

title: 英国航空航班在接近希思罗机场时呼叫求救
content: 图片来源，盖蒂图片社商业记者本·金和运输通讯员凯蒂·奥斯汀30分钟前发布根据法国事故调查机构的一份声明，本月早些时候，英国航空公司的一架航班在接近希思罗机场时发出了“求救”求救信号。7月6日，一架从德国杜塞尔多夫机场起飞的空客A320飞机在飞机上两次失速警告后发出了“求救”求救信号，随后飞机没有进一步着陆。英国航空事故调查局（AAIB）表示正在“调查一起严重事件”。英国航空公司发言人表示，该公司正在协助AAIB进行调查，现阶段在法律上无法进一步发表评论。法国航空安全调查局（BEA）表示，当飞机接近希思罗机场时，数据系统出现故障，引发了失速警告。机组人员随后以一种称为“替代法”的不同模式驾驶飞机，该模式消除了一些飞机失速警告。自动飞行保护系统。随后在 3,000 英尺处发生了另一次失速警告，专家称该位置可能距离机场仅几英里。机组人员已经发出的紧急呼叫升级为求救信号，表明危险迫在眉睫。BEA 网站将这一声明归因于 AAIB，但 AAIB 不愿证实该消息来自他们。他们发表了以下声明：“AAIB 正在调查一起涉及商用飞机的严重事故，这起事故于 7 月 6 日在接近希思罗机场时发生。”通信调查，这意味着不会派出任何团队进行现场调查。航空安全调查员大卫·格利夫表示，求救信号有不同形式，发送紧急信息“并不罕见”。“机上可能有需要紧急医疗护理的生病乘客……因此，机长可以自行决定他们的呼叫内容，但飞机上发生重大故障是非常不寻常的。”机场

title: 随着公司对成本变得越来越敏感，OpenAI 降低了其两个 GPT-5.6 AI 模型的价格
content:
OpenAIon 周四宣布，在其两款最新的人工智能模型 GPT-5.6 Terra 和 GPT-5.6 Luna 公开发布大约三周后，将大幅降价。

该公司面临着迎合对成本更加敏感的客户群的压力，在这些客户群中，企业不太愿意在没有明确投资回报的情况下部署昂贵的模型。它还致力于抵御来自中国初创公司和科技巨头谷歌和微软的竞争，这些公司一直在宣传具有成本效益的模型。

OpenAI 在其 GPT-5.6 系列中推出了三种模型，包括最强大的产品 Sol、中层模型 Terra 和最快的产品 Luna。

该公司周四表示，将 Terra 的价格降低 20%，至每百万输入代币 2 美元和 12 美元。每百万输出代币。它将 Luna 的成本削减了 80%，达到每百万个输入代币 20 美分，每百万个输出代币 1.20 美元。 Sol 的定价保持不变。

OpenAI 在一份新闻稿中表示：“我们的战略仍然专注于提高功能和效率，以便每一代智能技术都能以更低的成本完成更多的工作。”

OpenAI 在 2022 年推出 ChatGPT，引发了人工智能热潮，促使美国各地的公司争相部署该技术并激励其员工采用该技术。所谓的代币最大化时代诞生了，雇主鼓励员工尽可能多地使用人工智能，而不必担心成本。

但随着人工智能账单不断膨胀，有时达到数十亿美元，许多公司一直在积极努力控制支出。人工智能开发人员一直在密切关注这一转变，特别是当中国的开放权重模型迅速赶上领先的专有产品时。

开放权重人工智能模型可供用户下载、修改并在自己的基础设施上运行，并且可以作为公司经济高效的选择。中国初创公司 Moonshot AI 本月早些时候发布了一款名为 Kimi K3 的开放权重模型，该模型在某些行业基准测试中的性能优于美国的尖端产品，引起了硅谷的迅速反应。

在 Moonshot 宣布这一消息后，OpenAI 的主要竞争对手 Anthropic 发布了一款名为 Claude Opus 5 的新模型，并称其为许多用例中性能最佳、最具成本效益的产品。它的价格只有 Anthropic 在 6 月推出的高级模型 Claude Fable 5 的一半，尽管它在编码和知识工作任务方面的性能相当。

微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 在周三与投资者举行的季度财报电话会议上反复强调了公司的经济高效模型，此前该公司在本周早些时候推出了所谓的廉价但高性能的网络安全模型。

谷歌本月还推出了三款新模型，旨在在成本上低于竞争对手。该公司表示，Gemini 3.6 Flash 是其新产品中最强大的产品，每项任务比 Kimi K3 和其他中国型号更便宜。

title: 亚马逊将于盘后公布财报，云计算、资本支出成为焦点
content:
亚马逊将于周四盘后公布第二季度收益。

根据伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 的估计，分析师的预期如下：

华尔街也在关注其他关键收入数据：

投资者正在关注亚马逊和其他所谓的超大规模企业的资本支出，因为围绕人工智能的大规模投资的情绪变得越来越紧张。Alphabetshares上周，该公司将今年的 ITscapex 预测上调至 2050 亿美元，导致该公司股价下跌。

周四，微软公布好于预期的收益并重申其 2026 年资本支出计划后，该公司股价飙升 15%。与此同时，Meta 的股价下跌 9%，因为该公司对本季度的收入预测较低，其人工智能押注正在蚕食其现金。

亚马逊第一季度的资本支出达到 442 亿美元，同比增长 77%，根据 FactSet 数据，该数字预计在第二季度将进一步攀升至 493 亿美元。

该公司维持 2 月份的指引不变，即 2026 年资本支出将达到约 2000 亿美元。但一些分析师预计亚马逊将追随 Alphabet 的脚步，并提高其对 2026 年资本支出的预测。摩根士丹利的分析师在本月早些时候的一份研究报告中写道，“生态系统仍然受到计算的限制，支出的紧迫性仍然很高。”他们现在预计亚马逊今年的资本支出将达到 2180 亿美元，并预测预算将持续增长到 2028 年，届时资本支出总额可能达到 3180 亿美元。

分析师还看好亚马逊的云业务，指出其“私人实验室交易”是“多年增长持久性”的催化剂。亚马逊继续深化与领先的人工智能提供商 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的云和芯片合作伙伴关系。今年 4 月，它与 Meta 达成了一项协议，为这家社交网络巨头提供 AWS Graviton 芯片。

摩根士丹利分析师写道：“我们还认为，AWS 能够访问几乎所有领先模型、小型/中型和定制模型，这使其成为优化每项任务代币成本成为关键的世界中的赢家。”

在亚马逊的主要竞争对手均发布强劲业绩后，云增长将成为焦点。最近一个季度，谷歌云收入同比增长 82%。微软的 Azure 云收入在第四财季增长了 43%。

根据 StreetAccount 的数据，AWS 收入预计将比一年前增长约 31%，而第一季度的增长率为 28%，这是三年多来最快的扩张速度。

虽然亚马逊继续投资人工智能，但它已经削减了公司员工数量。近几个月来，该公司对客户服务和卖家支持部门进行了裁员。

上周，它宣布了通用人工智能部门的裁员，这是继亚马逊任命了新的 AGI 领导者以及 AGI 实验室负责人宣布离职后该部门的最新重组。

第二季度，亚马逊举办了年度 Prime Day 折扣盛会。该公司将这一活动从通常的 7 月时间范围提前，理由是世界杯和美国独立 250 周年纪念日非常繁忙。

瑞穗分析师在周一的一份报告中写道，这一时间安排可能会导致亚马逊北美零售额增长在第三季度放缓，然后在第四季度重新加速。

美国Adobe 的数据显示，6 月 23 日至 26 日期间，所有零售商的在线支出同比增长约 9.3%，达到 264 亿美元。亚马逊没有公布该活动的销售数据。

Evercore 分析师在本周早些时候给客户的一份报告中称该活动“相当成功”。 KeyBanc 的分析师表示，他们的专有数据显示，Prime 周支出增长了 41.7%，而去年为 50.5%，这表明该活动“很强劲，但不如去年那么强劲。”

亚马逊股价今年迄今上涨约 3%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨约 8%。

title: 消息人士称，人工智能明星投资者利奥波德·阿申布伦纳 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 在遭受巨额损失后正在平仓
content:
据知情人士透露，由前 OpenAI 研究员 Leopold Aschenbrenner 创立的规模 240 亿美元的对冲基金正在平仓，因为人工智能股票遭受了巨大损失，而且做空软件股票的错误赌注导致该基金急于筹集现金。

Situational Awareness 最近几周遭受了重大损失，因为其 SK Hynix 等人工智能基础设施投资组合下降，同时空头了诸如 SK Hynix 等软件公司的空头头寸。知情人士称，由于 Adobe 强烈反对该基金。

据知情人士透露，该公司的几家主要经纪商——包括美国银行、高盛和摩根大通——一直在与该基金合作，以寻求满足保证金要求或有序减少头寸。据知情人士透露，在今天的交易开始之前，经纪商一直在以多头和空头的方式出售该公司的一批持股。

情况仍然不稳定。目前无法确定该公司是否通过协商资产出售来满足保证金要求，或者是否正在对其投资组合进行更广泛的清算。

据知情人士透露，该基金还一直试图通过出售私营公司的股份来提高流动性。这些努力包括对 Anthropic 的投资。所提供的职位规模无法确定，但知情人士表示，潜在买家已表示有兴趣购买部分或全部股权。

态势感知公司没有立即回复置评请求。

这场动荡是对投资论点的早期且潜在的重大考验，正是这一论点使阿申布伦纳成为人工智能行业最受关注的人物之一。这位 25 岁的年轻人创立公司的理念是，日益强大的人工智能系统需要大幅扩展芯片、内存、数据中心和发电能力。该基金的强制平仓可能会给一些从投资者对该扩建项目的热情中获益最多的公司带来压力。

根据备案文件，该基金在第一季度末持有的最大股份包括Nebius Group、Sandisk、MicronandCoreWeave。这四只股票本月均下跌超过 35%。

阿申布伦纳 (Aschenbrenner) 在 2024 年发表了一系列文章，认为人工智能的快速发展需要计算能力、先进半导体、内存和能源基础设施的大幅扩展，从而在科技和投资界崭露头角。这些想法在他离开 OpenAI 后成为了态势感知的知识基础。

Aschenbrenner 19 岁时以告别演说者的身份从哥伦比亚大学毕业，随后加入了 OpenAI 的 Superalignment 团队。他于 2024 年因不当披露内部信息而被公司解雇。 Aschenbrenner 对这种描述提出了异议，称他与外部研究人员分享了一份基本上非机密的规划文件以寻求反馈，并表示他的解雇是在他对 OpenAI 安全实践提出警告而引发的紧张局势之后发生的。 OpenAI 表示，这些担忧与他的离职无关。

根据《财富》杂志 10 月份的一份简介，其中引用了 Situational Awareness LP 发言人的话说，阿申布伦纳已与 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 的幕僚长阿维塔尔·巴尔维特 (Avital Balwit) 订婚。

该基金的损失规模、寻求筹集的金额以及任何资产出售的程度无法立即确定。

title: 埃及称，随着对能源基础设施的攻击扩大，无人机袭击了地中海港口的两艘船
content:
埃及周四表示，一架无人机击中了地中海达米埃塔港的两艘船只，对能源基础设施的攻击范围扩大到整个中东地区。

据国有中东通讯社报道，开罗表示，初步调查发现周三的无人机袭击导致船上起火。没有人声称对此次袭击负责。

据埃及石油和矿产资源部称，一艘再气化船和一艘储存船起火。

达米埃塔是一个液化天然气枢纽所在地。据贸易情报公司 Kpler 称，Energos Winter 浮式储存和再气化装置以及 GasLog Salem 液化天然气油轮遭到损坏。

该部在一份声明中表示，“通过主管当局以及现场消防和安全团队的协调努力，立即按照批准的紧急和快速反应计划处理了这一情况。”

这起无人认领的袭击发生之际，伊朗、其在也门的胡塞盟友和伊拉克民兵组织发起了袭击。扩大了对该地区能源基础设施的打击。尽管事态升级，周四原油期货小幅走低。

埃及的袭击表明，苏伊士运河附近的能源基础设施也面临安全威胁，因为胡塞武装试图控制红海南端曼德布海峡的交通。

胡塞武装上周宣布对沙特阿拉伯实施海上禁运，危及该国通过红海的能源出口。

沙特可以通过一条横跨埃及的管道重新引导一些石油。但利雅得必须在管道上卸下一些石油，然后在地中海沿岸取回货物，因为苏伊士运河对于满载的超级油轮来说太浅了。

与此同时，美国隔夜对伊朗发动了新一波打击，以报复伊斯兰革命卫队对中东美军的突然导弹袭击。

胡塞武装周一声称，他们的目标是沙特阿拉伯的管道基础设施，这些基础设施将石油输送到沙特阿拉伯红海港口延布。随着伊朗袭击油轮扰乱霍尔木兹海峡，该管道在将沙特石油出口推向市场方面发挥了关键作用。

与此同时，驻伊拉克的伊朗盟友民兵本周向沙特利雅得和东部地区的石油基础设施发射了无人机。美国和沙特战机周二对伊拉克民兵进行联合打击以进行报复。

title: 第二季度盈利超出预期后，法拉利上调 2026 年业绩指引
content:
由于对著名意大利跑车品牌产品的健康需求，法拉利第二季度超出了华尔街的预期，因此上调了其 2026 年业绩指引。

该公司第二季度的表现与伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 编制的平均预期相比如下：

这家汽车制造商新的 2026 年业绩指引包括约 76 亿欧元的收入，高于 75 亿欧元；调整后收益至少为29.7亿欧元，即调整后每股收益9.68欧元，高于29.3亿欧元，即调整后每股收益9.45欧元；以及工业自由现金流以及调整后收益和营业利润的小幅增长。

法拉利首席执行官 Benedetto Vigna 将公司第二季度业绩和指导增长归因于“个性化的持续趋势”以及对其车辆的弹性需求，其订单簿到 2027 年已满。

加拿大皇家银行资本市场分析师 Tom Narayan 指出，提高指导的时机对投资者来说很重要：“法拉利很少提高其指导第二季度，而不是第三季度，因此我们认为这是今年剩余时间的积极指标，预计股价会走高。”

该公司股价在周四盘前交易中上涨约 2%。

法拉利第二季度业绩包括营业利润 6.05 亿欧元，利润率 31.2%，净利润 4.63 亿欧元，较上年同期增长约 9%早些时候。
